plain: Badge now centres its label in the pill (it sat about 2px high), the label sits in an inner span, and the unused --component-badge-paddingShift token is gone.

steps.plain: A Badge's text is wrapped in an inner span, so a test that reads the Badge with getByText or textContent's parent now gets the span; query the Badge by role, test id or closest('[data-tone]') instead. Components that show a Badge (Board, Card, DataTableSection, List, PageHeader, StatusListItem, StatusTile, Table, Text demos) carry the same extra span.
The component.badge.paddingShift token (--component-badge-paddingShift, the 1px label lift) is gone because Badge pads evenly now; stop reading it, there is no replacement.
